dataset: original full snapshot, not quality train or Part2d fixture
users: 10 sorted actual userIds at zero-based floor(k*(U-1)/9), k=0..9
warmup: one full untimed workload per method
order: even zero-based passes user then item; odd item then user
scope: actual production recommendation query, default Top5, no trace or DOM; includes cosine validation, neighbour selection, accumulation, sorting
initialization: 5 separate loadData calls with fetch/decode, parse/validate, matrix/columns timings; browser HTTP cache default, server no Cache-Control, not cold-network latency
summary: median and linear-interpolated IQR of workload total per pass, per-user median range
